newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong population grows 13 pct in decade - census.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong population grows 13 pct in decade - census.

text.p: The population of Hong Kong grew by 13 percent in the past 10 years, government figures released on Tuesday show.
The figures put the resident population of the British territory at 6,218,000 as of March this year, a rise of 722,000 people over the decade.
Frederick Ho Wing-huen, the Commissioner for Census and Statistics, said the labour force had grown from 2.8 million to 3.2 million since 1986.
